summary: Measured on this box 2026-09-19: ~/.mcp.json holds 34 servers (not 19; tui-inventory.json, the GT-cited artifact, never covered this surface). Of the 21 named items: 7 are SSOT-documented byte-identical (agent-mail, angr, apify, cursor-bridge, github-security, nuclei, osint - premise 'undocumented' fails for these), 2 are SSOT name-variants (cve == cve-mcp @31411; ~/.mcp.json semgrep == semgrep-hub @31419 and conflicts with SSOT's stdio semgrep), 11 are deliberate-but-unregistered (metasploit, sliver, sliver-full, hacktricks, firecrawl-kit on dead hexstrike supervisor ports 31380/31381/31414-31416; search-hub + cloud-hub as on-disk toolchain hub.py builds; brightdata; tooluniverse (uvx-pinned, .claude.json-only - not even in ~/.mcp.json); playwright-cdp/-extension), and 1 rogue (fiddler, .claude.json-only localhost:8868, zero provenance, dead). ~/.mcp.json is not a sync_shared_state.ps1 target - it is a pre-SSOT legacy fleet home loaded as project scope for HOME-cwd sessions, shadowing 25 same-name user-scope entries. Banner 'failed to connect' for the 31xxx family is backend-down (curl: 000), not unconfigured. agent-mail is healthy at 18812 (8812 doc refs are stale). Bonus SSOT-absent: social-hub, McpHub. Recommended single fix: one registration pass into ~/.agents/agents.json for the 11 (+2 bonus), delete the cve alias and the redundant ~/.mcp.json copies, and resolve the cursor-bridge G-32 tension at owner level. All absences double-confirmed by raw-text grep of ~/.agents/agents.json with a passing known-present detector control.
